description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams which extends FilterParams and is used to specify search filter parameters related to employee supervisors in the OrangeHRM system. It manages the employee number and sorting fields for search queries.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class for holding search filter parameters related to employee supervisors, including employee number and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'supervisor.lastName'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the search filter, if set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number in the search filter parameters.
